messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cyclobenzaprine works by reducing the nerve signals in the brain that drive muscle tone and spasm, which allows tight, overactive muscles to relax. It acts within the central nervous system, primarily at the level of the brain stem, and does not act on the muscles themselves or at the junction between nerves and muscle. 1,2 Because cyclobenzaprine works through the nervous system in this way, it will not relieve muscle spasm caused by central nervous system disease, such as cerebral palsy or spinal cord disease. 1,2
The way cyclobenzaprine works in fibromyalgia is not known. Laboratory studies show it blocks several receptor types, including serotonin (5-HT2A), histamine, and muscarinic receptors. 3
Cyclobenzaprine is chemically related to tricyclic antidepressants such as amitriptyline, which explains several of its side effects (such as drowsiness and dry mouth) and some of its most important drug interactions. 1,2
Triplet: ["cyclobenzaprine", "reduces nerve signals", "muscle tone and spasm"]

The relation 'reduces nerve signals' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug decreases the transmission of nerve signals that contribute to the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
B. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect variation': The occurrence or severity of side effects from the subject drug may be influenced by the object entity.
E. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
